title: Snake and Ladder
summary: Build a turn-based Snake and Ladder game where the die can be swapped between fair and crooked without touching the game loop, and the board refuses layouts where one jump chains into another.
concepts: Validating invariants at construction rather than at use
Returning values instead of printing, so the domain is testable
extensions: Rolling a six earns the player another turn
Place snakes and ladders randomly at setup while keeping the no-chain rule
Support rolling more than one die per turn
Save and resume a game in progress
